_about: The payload corpus. Data, not code: adding a dialect is an entry here, and scripts/payloads.py never changes.
_contract: Every value is a SUFFIX appended to the parameter's original value, so id=1 is sent as id=1'. Nothing here replaces the value.
_and_only: boolean and time entries use AND, never OR. Confirmation needs an asymmetry - TRUE matches the baseline, FALSE differs - and an OR-TRUE returns every row, so it differs too and a vulnerable parameter scores clean. OR is for exploitation, after detection.
_detection_only: Nothing here extracts data. No UNION column dumping, no extractvalue, no stacked writes. The goal is evidence that injection exists, and stopping there is what keeps this safe to point at someone else's application.

error_suffix.note: single quote. The one payload that finds most of everything
breaks backslash escaping, and escapes the closing quote in multi-field queries
balanced pair. Silence here plus noise from a single quote is itself the string-context proof
MySQL identifier quote, reaches ORDER BY and column-name positions
unbalanced LIKE wildcard. Weak on its own, useful next to a quote

context_proof.note: MySQL and most engines. Trailing space is mandatory
MySQL hash comment, for when -- is filtered
unterminated block comment swallows the rest of the statement
same proof in a double-quoted context

boolean_pairs.note: comment form, for a query with trailing clauses the quote form cannot balance
symbol form, for when the word AND is filtered

time.note: SQL Server has no inline sleep, so this needs stacked statements
reachable without the DBMS_LOCK privilege, unlike DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP
SQLite has no sleep. Allocating a large blob is the delay, roughly 2-3 seconds
